deriva(c::Number, x) = 0
deriva(s::Symbol, x) = s == x ? 1 : 0
function deriva(ex::Expr, x)
    op = ex.args[1]
    a = ex.args[2]
    if op == :+
        r = deriva(a, x)
        for b in ex.args[3:end]
            r = :($r + $(deriva(b, x)))
        end
        return r
    elseif op == :*
        b = ex.args[3]
        return :($(deriva(a, x)) * $b + $a * $(deriva(b, x)))
    elseif op == :^
        n = ex.args[3]
        return :($n * $a ^ ($n - 1) * $(deriva(a, x)))
    end
    error("no sé derivar $op")
end
